name: Lora Bergauz
backstory: Lora, also known as Lora Bergauz, is a human in Baldur's Gate, initially found during Act Three inside the Basilisk Gate Barracks. She is the mother of Vanra. Speaking to her can initiate the quest Save Vanra.
voice_hint: human cleric, light domain (voiced by Harriet Kershaw)
